data.name: Nirbhay
data.gender_notes: Nirbhay is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'nir-bhay', meaning 'without fear'. This name is often given to children as a symbol of bravery and strength. In Hindu mythology, Nirbhay is the name of a demon king who was feared by all for his power and invincibility. The name Nirbhay carries the meaning “Fearless, Courageous” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nirbhay usually hope their child will grow to embody fearless, courageous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace courage and fearlessness in your life journey.
data.etymology: Nirbhay belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fearless, Courageous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nirbhay total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

The name reminds us that true fearlessness comes not from the absence of external threats, but rather from the unshakable faith and trust in God.
